title: MULTINOMIAL: a private Lanczos lgamma, no discrepancy row, no numeric evidence
status_plain: MULTINOMIAL's only Excel evidence is a 2026-03-15 native-COM spot probe that pinned truncation and domain lanes -- MULTINOMIAL(0,0) -> 1 -- with no count. It appears in no discrepancy row. Yet it carries its OWN private Lanczos lgamma table in the kernel, which places it on the same substrate class as the GAMMA/COMBIN wall with zero numeric evidence either way. That is an evidence gap, not a clean result.
evidence_locality_note: The probe CSVs cited by the registry entry are under `.tmp/`, gitignored in OxFunc.
substrate: its own private Lanczos lgamma (`MULTINOMIAL_LANCZOS_G` / `MULTINOMIAL_LANCZOS_COEFFS`), distinct from the shared internal lgamma
open_question: MULTINOMIAL has never been compared to Excel on numeric bits, and its private Lanczos lgamma is the same class of substrate that GAMMA and COMBIN are known to diverge on.
reader_warning: This record publishes no numeric count. Any warrant MULTINOMIAL holds is earned on structural group evidence recorded elsewhere and must not be read as numeric agreement.
citations: content/evidence/harvest/RV-gamma-lgamma.md — the primary-source re-derivation this record follows
